hints.title: Time Normalization
hints.text: Convert each four-digit time string into total integer minutes: hours * 60 + minutes.

hints.title: Employee Grouping and Sorting
hints.text: Group access minute values by employee name and sort each employee's access timestamps in ascending order.

hints.title: 60-Minute Sliding Window Check
hints.text: If an employee has at least 3 accesses and times[i + 2] - times[i] < 60 for some index i, they are high access.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking unsorted timestamps requires comparing all triplets quadratically.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Convert 24-hour time to scalar minutes and check consecutive triplet differences.
